title: Asymptotic error distribution for tamed Euler method with coupled monotonicity condition
summary: This paper establishes the asymptotic error distribution of the tamed Euler method for stochastic differential equations (SDEs) with a coupled monotonicity condition, that is, the limit distribution of the corresponding normalized error process. Specifically, for SDEs driven by multiplicative noise, we first propose a tamed Euler method parameterized by $α\in (0, 1]$ and establish that its strong convergence rate is $α\wedge\frac{1}{2}$.
